attempts.rationale: The probe builds a fresh app, creates an owner, a target user, and a victim collaborator, grants the target admin access, has the target perform one admin action (removing the victim) to populate any per-session role cache, re-adds the victim, then has the owner revoke the target via A's DELETE route. In world A, requirePermission evaluates the store on every request, so the target's next admin attempt on the private repo is denied with 404. In world A+B, B's per-session cache still returns the cached admin role after revocation, so the same request succeeds with 204, causing the expected-404 assertion to fail. If A's revoke were a no-op, the target would also succeed in A and the probe would fail. In base and B, the revoke route is absent and Hono returns its default text/plain 404, which the probe detects and reports as n/a.
